decision: The compiled Plus 1.2.3 delta has an exact rebuild chain and its changed regions are mapped. No Plus-owned consumer of BlockB+0x1A/mask 0x003E was found in reviewed source/owned changed code. Do not claim global ownership or authorize persisted nature storage yet: stage0 overlay 12 has a residual unclassified changed region; outer Box/PC/daycare paths are not exhaustively mapped.
scope: Offline binary/source provenance audit. No ROM writes, emulator/core, save mutation, or runtime claims. All binary extraction used existing ndspy and read-only ROM inputs; stage0 was decoded from the pinned delta into a new QA staging path.

extraction.method: Existing ndspy NintendoDSRom.loadArm9() section buffers and decompressed overlay buffers; SHA-256 calculated per ROM, section and overlay; adjacent versions compared bytewise. BSS/layout changes recorded separately from file-backed bytes.

compiled_field114.setter_effect: Writes full u16 at PokemonDataBlockB+0x1A without a field-specific mask.
compiled_field114.dispatchers: Field 114 entries are mapped in the prior report; the exact getter/setter wrapper, dispatch and case ranges are byte-identical in clean Plus, FIX6a and 998. This audit additionally compared full section/overlay chains from retail through Plus to those targets.

component_ownership.plus_17_step_source: The exact 17-stage chain is preserved in build_chain and all changed sections/overlay byte ranges appear in transitions. The Plus reserve area at 0x023D8000 and later 0x023D7000/6000/5000 allocations is listed by section SHA/size; specific call-site assignments below are source-mapped only when a source owner exists.
known_plus_call_sites: plus_chunk source hooks include trainer/save paths; Wild hook in overlay 2.
Final capacity changes include ARM9 and overlays 15; source-owned by the bag-capacity feature.
SpeedUp delta changes seven documented ARM9 instruction/data ranges (18 bytes); source user_config.s identifies speed counter and fast-text behavior.
stage0_non_plus_changes: Stage0 main ARM9 byte ranges are recorded exactly in transitions; many early game/Drayano changes are not individual source-mapped by this audit.
Stage0 overlay 2 hunk at 0x0224BB06 maps to PlayerStepEvent_RepelCounterDecrement in upstream asm.
Stage0 overlay 15 hunk at 0x021FBAD6 falls in AreaDataManager_Load range; no nature/block accessor relation established.
Stage0 overlay 18 hunks are static table bytes; semantics not fully attributed here.

Stage0 overlay 12 contains residual changed code/data at 0x022474A2, 0x022474A4 and a pointer/table hunk at 0x0225204C. The first two are inside an unlabelled Thumb region in the matching upstream overlay assembly; caller/feature ownership remains unclassified. This is the outstanding concrete code-map gap.

limits: Bytewise ARM9 autoload sections and all 129 overlays were compared across the exact chain; this is not a proof that all runtime copies/consumers of the word are represented by these files.
Plus tracked source review covered 44 C/H/assembly/include files and found no named field114/unused2/0x003E/0x001A consumer; absence in a bounded source search is not global absence.
Party field114 getter/setter are mapped. Outer BoxMon wrappers and PC/daycare/battle copied structures are not exhaustively mapped.
The unresolved stage0 overlay 12 hunk needs function/caller ownership classification before claiming fully classified changed code.
No runtime, cross-box/PC, persistence or game-flow acceptance was performed.
next_gate: Resolve overlay 12 region/callers against the exact stage0/Drayano provenance, then map outer BoxMon and PC/daycare/battle routes. Until then, storage is not cleared for product use; a throwaway isolated prototype may be considered only if it does not assert persistent/global safety.
